payload.summary: PR #505 merged into the supervisor roadmap integration branch after two fully green CI runs. All OpenSpec tasks are complete, so no migration is required; cleanup proceeds to archive the change and refresh derived decision artifacts.

decisions.title: Preserve the stacked roadmap topology with a merge commit
decisions.rationale: GitHub rejected rebase because the RI-10 branch intentionally contains a merge commit from synchronizing current main; the repository permits merge commits and PR #505 remained CLEAN and MERGEABLE.

decisions.title: No task migration
decisions.rationale: Every RI-10 task is checked, so there are no residual tasks to move into a follow-up proposal or issue.
